nodes.title: Requirements
nodes.description:
This document specifies the Vireo 55 television set and its VR-7 remote control, item 220.3 of the LARK programme.
The requirements in this document are used for the design and the acceptance of the television set and its remote control.
nodes.decision_reason: A wrapper named 'Requirements' that holds both systems and the shared areas. Proposed: name it after the product on the cover, as the job does for the TV-remote mock.

nodes.title: General
nodes.decision_reason: A generic name holding only 'Product family'; it moves up a level.
